asked: a bacterium that eats carbon and swims

genotype.note: no blueprint was built, so there is no cell list and no markers.

mesh.why: no blueprint, no hierarchy, no mesh. The mesh builder is a parametric teleost builder in any case.

what_it_taught: The request names no organism the tool can read, and the tool now says so instead of building an animal. "Bacterium" is not a taxon word in this repository; a scientific name is the way in.
question: Can we design a bacterium that eats carbon, and could it live anywhere?
